title: OpenAI floats giving Trump administration 5 percent cut of AI boom
raw_excerpt: OpenAI has floated giving the US government a 5 percent ownership stake as a way of easing tensions with the Trump administration and blunting mounting public backlash against AI, according to the Financial Times . CEO Sam Altman argued that giving the public a financial interest in the company would be the best way to share the upside of AI, the FT reported, citing two unnamed people familiar with the talks. He's said to have first pitched the idea to Trump early last year. Altman reportedly suggested the 5 percent figure. summary: OpenAI 向特朗普政府提议，通过主权财富基金给予美国政府 5% 的所有权股份，以缓解政治压力并分享 AI 红利。CEO Sam Altman 认为这是让公众分享 AI 收益的最佳方式。此举可能重塑 AI 行业与政府的关系，引发关于 AI 治理和利益分配的广泛讨论。

title: Meta Is Planning a Cloud Business to Sell AI Computing Power
raw_excerpt: Meta Platforms is developing an internal cloud infrastructure initiative to sell access to its surplus AI computing power and hosted models to external developers. This strategic pivot aims to generate a new revenue stream from the company's massive multi-billion-dollar investments in data centers and chips, directly challenging dominant hyperscalers like Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
summary: Meta 正计划推出云基础设施服务，向外部开发者出售其过剩的 AI 算力和托管模型，直接挑战 AWS、Azure 和 Google Cloud。此举旨在将 Meta 在数据中心和芯片上的巨额投资转化为新的收入来源，标志着大型科技公司 AI 商业模式的重大转变。

title: 全球首个英伟达含量为0的万亿模型，成了海外开发者的抢手货

title: Seed2.0 Model Card: Towards Intelligence Frontier for Real-World Complexity

title: usestrix/strix
raw_excerpt: Open-source AI penetration testing tool to find and fix your app’s vulnerabilities.
summary: Strix 是一款开源的 AI 渗透测试工具，可自动发现并修复应用中的安全漏洞。它利用 AI 技术模拟攻击，帮助开发者在开发早期识别风险，降低安全成本。该项目在 GitHub 上今日获得 2137 星，反映了社区对 AI 安全工具的高度关注。

title: Continual Harness: An Efficient Self-Improving Agent on ARC-AGI-3
raw_excerpt: The ARC-AGI-3 benchmark tests agents' ability to form and update an internal world model through ongoing learning. Continual Harness aims to efficiently enhance agents' self-improvement capabilities on this challenging IQ test.
summary: Continual Harness 是一种高效的自我改进智能体框架，专注于在 ARC-AGI-3 基准测试上提升智能体的世界模型更新能力。该测试要求智能体通过持续学习形成和更新内部世界模型，是衡量通用人工智能能力的重要挑战。

title: 世界模型的新用途：不做选手，去当裁判
summary: 世界模型被赋予新用途——不再作为选手直接参与任务，而是充当裁判评估其他 AI 系统的表现。这种角色转换利用了世界模型对环境的深刻理解，为 AI 系统的安全性和可靠性提供更客观的评估标准，开辟了世界模型应用的新方向。

title: Claude-real-video － any LLM can watch a video
summary: 开源项目 claude-real-video 让任意 LLM 能够观看视频，通过将视频帧序列转化为模型可理解的输入，实现了视频理解能力。该项目在 Hacker News 上获得 113 分，展示了将多模态能力扩展到现有语言模型的低成本路径。

title: A New Look at AI's Impact on Jobs: Firm-Level AI Spending and Workforce Adjustment
raw_excerpt: A joint study by Ramp and Revelio Labs analyzed the relationship between firm-level generative AI investments and employment outcomes across over 21,000 companies in the US. The research reveals that companies with high-intensity AI spending grew their overall headcount by 10.2 percent and entry-level positions by 12 percent over the two years following adoption.
summary: Ramp 与 Revelio Labs 联合研究分析了 21000 多家美国公司的 AI 投资与就业关系。结果显示，高 AI 投入公司在采用 AI 两年后整体员工数增长 10.2%，初级岗位增长 12%，驳斥了 AI 导致大规模失业的悲观论调，为 AI 对劳动力市场的影响提供了新数据。
